feeConvention.name: round_trip_on_entry_notional
feeConvention.commission: 0.05% of entry price × shares, once per closed trade
feeConvention.not: 0.05% per ticket on both entry and exit
feeConvention.slippage: $0.02 per share on the entry fill and $0.02 per share on the exit, inside prices, not inside commission

sensitivityIfBothLegsChargedAt5bps.note: Not the frozen model. Shown only so the 0.05%-per-ticket reading is quantified.

execution.rule: Fill = next open ± $0.02. Exit raw from stop/target/close, then ± $0.02 adverse. If stop and target print on the same bar, stop wins.
